design.init: shared source9900 actor; paired fresh critic and empty Adam
design.primary_unit: paired continuation training seed; maps crossed; episodes nested
limitations: open-loop ablations change phase/state joint distribution
three old mechanism lineages are not new training repeats

environment.reproducibility: GPU environment evaluation with CPU ONNX policy inference; independent GPU rerun required

failure_action: stop on technical failure; preserve raw/budget/resources; no automatic retry
scientific_action: complete fixed matrix, analyze negative/inconclusive outcomes without added budget
recovery_rule: one new attempt only after original C>=10GiB/E>=15GiB disk gates pass; no automatic retry
